run_pointnav_example: run the habitat point navigation example that steps an agent through a random episode
create_habitat_env: create a habitat environment using habitat.Env with a pointnav config file
load_habitat_config: load a habitat task configuration using habitat.get_config with a yaml path
reset_environment: reset the habitat environment and return initial observations using env.reset
step_agent: step the agent in the environment with a sampled action using env.step
